title: Towards a framework for evaluating the safety, acceptability and efficacy of AI systems for health: an initial synthesis
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a framework for evaluating AI in healthcare and does not measure any aspect of religion or faith.
findings: The paper does not analyze religion or faith. Its main finding is a four-stage framework (Preclinical, Exploratory, Definitive, Post-Market Surveillance) for evaluating the safety, acceptability, and efficacy of AI systems in healthcare.
